🚨 UPDATE: SAP's security incident is taking a potentially serious turn.

The suspicious activity confirmed by SAP has now been linked to GitHub, according to internal staff communications reviewed by German news agency dpa.

SAP has reportedly restricted GitHub access, suspended automated development processes and replaced its signing keys.

More concerningly, Der Spiegel reports that attackers allegedly stole employee authentication tokens, allowing them to copy and modify source code. SAP has not independently confirmed these claims.

The incident raises serious concerns about source code integrity and a potential software supply chain compromise at one of the world's largest enterprise software providers.

SAP maintains that it has found no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data. There is also no evidence reported so far that modified code reached customers.

The full scope of the incident remains unclear.

#SAP #GitHub #Cybersecurity #DataBreach #SupplyChainAttack #InfoSec
